text: Poleti se pazite tudi nordijskih komarjev. Čeprav ne prenašajo nobenih bolezni, so lahko zelo nadležni.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Ima raznoliko gospodarstvo, vendar je gospodarstvo San Francisca z njim povezano, saj gre za svetovno znano turistično znamenitost.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Največje zaposlitvene panoge so strokovne storitve, država, finance, trgovina in turizem.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Zaradi pogostega pojavljanja v glasbi, filmih, književnosti in popularni kulturi je mesto s svojimi znamenitostmi poznano po vsem svetu.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco je razvil veliko turistično infrastrukturo s številnimi hoteli, restavracijami in prvorazrednimi prostori za kongrese.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco je tudi eno od najboljših mest v državi za druge azijske kuhinje: korejsko, tajsko, indijsko in japonsko.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Potovanje v Walt Disney World je za številne ameriške družine velika romarska pot.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: "Značilni" izlet vključuje pristanek na mednarodnem letališču v Orlandu, avtobusni prevoz do Disneyjevega hotela, enotedensko bivanje znotraj zidov Disneyjevega posestva in povratek domov.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Možnih je nešteto variant, vendar je to tisto, kar ima največ ljudi v mislih, ko govorijo o "obisku Disney Worlda".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Veliko vstopnic, ki se prodajajo na dražbenih spletnih mestih, kot sta eBay in Craigslist, je delno porabljenih, večdnevnih vstopnic za vstop v več parkov.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Ta dejavnost je sicer zelo pogosta, vendar jo družba Disney prepoveduje: vozovnice niso prenosljive.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Za vsako taborjenje pod robom v Velikem kanjonu je potrebno dovoljenje za zadrževanje na podeželju.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Dovoljenja so zaradi zaščite soteske omejena in so na voljo od 1. dne v mesecu naprej, štiri mesece pred mesecem začetka.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Tako je dovolilnica za taborjenje v divjini za katerikoli začetni datum v maju na voljo od 1. januarja.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Namestitvene kapacitete najbolj priljubljenih območij, kot je kamp Bright Angel v bližini Phantom Rancha, se običajno napolnijo že prvi dan po odprtju rezervacij.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Omejeno število dovoljenj je rezervirano za prošnje na samem kraju, ki so na voljo na podlagi načela »kdor prej pride, prej dobi«.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Prihod v južno Afriko z avtomobilom je čudovit način za ogled lepot te pokrajine, kakor tudi za obisk krajev, ki se nahajajo izven ustaljenih turističnih poti.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Z dobrim načrtovanjem lahko uporabite običajen avto, vendar svetujejo uporabo avtomobila 4 x 4, saj je veliko lokacij dostopnih samo z dvignjenimi vozili s štirikolesnim pogonom.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Pri načrtovanju upoštevajte, da je Južna Afrika sicer stabilna, niso pa stabilne tudi vse njene sosede.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Zahteve in stroški za vizo se razlikujejo od države do države in so odvisni od države, iz katere prihajate.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Vsaka država ima tudi posebne zakone, ki določajo, katera oprema za nujne primere mora biti v avtomobilu.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls je mesto v zahodnem delu Zimbabveja, na drugi strani meje od Livingstona v Zambiji in blizu Bocvane.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Mesto leži neposredno ob slapovih, ki so največja znamenitost, vendar ta priljubljena turistična točka pustolovcem in ljubiteljem znamenitosti nudi tudi druge možnosti raziskovanja za daljše bivanje.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: V deževnem obdobju (od novembra do marca) se poveča količina vode, zato so slapovi še bolj dramatični.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Če boste prečkali most ali hodili po poteh, ki se vijejo v bližini Slapov, se boste zagotovo zmočili.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Po drugi strani pa ravno velika količina vode povzroča, da je vaš pogled na dejanske slapove zamegljen – zaradi vse te vode!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tutankamonova grobnica (KV62). KV62 je morda najbolj znana grobnica v Dolini, prizorišče, kjer je Howard Carter leta 1922 odkril skoraj nedotaknjen kraljevi grob mladega kralja.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Nasprotno pa je grobnica Tutankamona v primerjavi z drugimi kraljevimi grobnicami komaj vredna ogleda, saj je veliko manjša in le borno okrašena.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Vsakdo, ki želi videti znake poškodb mumije, do katerih je prišlo med poskusi, da bi jo odstranili iz krste, bo razočaran, saj je mogoče videti samo glavo in ramena.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Bajnih zakladov grobnice ni več v njej, saj so jih prenesli v Egipčanski muzej v Kairu.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Za obiskovalce, ki imajo omejen čas, bi bilo bolje, da ga preživijo drugje.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km jugozahodno od mesta Siem Reap. Ta tempelj, ki je na vrhu hriba, je bil zgrajen konec 9. stoletja, v času vladavine kralja Yasovarmana.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Na hrib se je vredno povzpeti zaradi mračnega vzdušja v templju in razgleda nad jezerom Tonle Sap.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Obisk tega kraja lahko prikladno združite še z vožnjo z ladjico do jezera.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Za vstop v tempelj potrebujete prepustnico Angkor Pass, zato ne pozabite s seboj vzeti svojega potnega lista, ko se odpravljate v Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jeruzalem je prestolnica in največje mesto Izraela, vendar pa ga večina držav ter Združeni narodi ne priznavajo za glavno mesto Izraela.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Starodavno mesto v Judejskem hribovju ima osupljivo zgodovino, ki obsega na tisoče let.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Je sveto mesto treh monoteističnih religij – judovstva, krščanstva in islama, in služi kot duhovno, versko in kulturno središče.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Zaradi verskega pomena mesta in posebno zaradi številnih najdišč na območju Starega mesta je Jeruzalem glavna turistična destinacija v Izraelu.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jeruzalem ima veliko zgodovinskih, arheoloških in kulturnih znamenitosti, poleg tega pa tudi živahna in nabito polna nakupovalna središča, kavarne in restavracije.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekvador od državljanov Kube zahteva, da pred vstopom v državo na mednarodnih letališčih ali mejnih kontrolnih točkah pridobijo garantno pismo.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: To pismo mora legalizirati ekvadorsko Ministrstvo za zunanje zadeve, prav tako pa mora izpolnjevati določene pogoje.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Te zahteve so namenjene temu, da se zagotovi organiziran migracijski pretok med državama.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Državljani Kube, ki imajo zeleno karto Združenih držav Amerike, morajo za pridobitev izvzetja te zahteve obiskati ekvadorski konzulat.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Vaš potni list mora biti veljaven še najmanj 6 mesecev po datumu potovanja. Za dokazovanje trajanja bivanja je potrebna povratna vozovnica/vozovnica za nadaljevanje potovanja.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ogledi so cenejši za večje skupine, če ste torej sami ali samo z enim prijateljem, poskušajte najti še druge in oblikujte skupino od štiri do šest ljudi za boljšo ceno na osebo.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Vseeno pa se s tem ni potrebno obremenjevati, saj turiste pogosto prestavljajo tako, da napolnijo avtomobile.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Gre bolj za način, s katerim prepričajo ljudi, da plačajo več.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ta strma gora, ki je pogosto v ozadju na številnih fotografijah ruševin, se dviguje nad severnim delom Machu Picchuja.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Od spodaj izgleda nekoliko zastrašujoče, vzpon je tudi strm in težek, vendar bi ga morala vsaka fizično pripravljena oseba premagati v približno 45 minutah.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Kamnite stopnice so položene po skoraj celotni poti, strmejši deli pa so opremljeni tudi z jeklenimi vrvmi za boljši oprijem.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Vendar pričakujte veliko mero fizičnega napora in bodite previdni na strmejših delih, posebno v mokrem vremenu, saj lahko hitro postane nevarno.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Pri vrhu je zelo majhna jama, skozi katero je treba priti. Zelo je nizka in tesna.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Otok in divje živali na Galapaških otokih si je najbolje ogledati z ladjo, tako kot je to storil Charles Darwin leta 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Po vodah Galapagosa pluje več kot 60 križark – ki glede na velikost sprejmejo od 8 do 100 potnikov.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Večina ljudi opravi rezervacijo veliko vnaprej (saj so ladje na vrhuncu sezone običajno polne).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Rezervacijo vsekakor opravite prek agencije, ki je specializirana za Galapagos in dobro pozna vse vrste ladij.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Tako bo izbira ladje prilagojena vašim posebnim željam in/ali omejitvam.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Pred prihodom Špancev v 16. stoletju je severni Čile pripadal Inkom, osrednji in južni del Čila pa so naseljevali domorodni Aravkani (Mapuči).
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuči so bili ena zadnjih neodvisnih ameriških staroselskih skupin, ki so se uspeli ubraniti pritiskom špansko govorečega okolja vse do razglasitve neodvisnosti Čila.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Čeprav je Čile neodvisnost razglasil leta 1810 (sredi Napoleonovih vojn, zaradi katerih je bila Španija nekaj let brez delujoče centralne vlade), odločilne zmage nad Španijo ni bilo do leta 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominikanska Republika (špansko: República Dominicana) je karibska država, ki zavzema vzhodno polovico otoka Hispaniola, katerega si deli s Haitijem.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Poleg belih peščenih plaž in hribovite pokrajine se ta država ponaša tudi z najstarejšim evropskim mestom v obeh Amerikah, ki je danes del Santa Dominga.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Otok so prvi naselili Taini in Karibi. Karibi so bili aravaško govoreče ljudstvo, ki je prišlo okoli leta 10.000 pr. n. š.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: V le nekaj letih po prihodu evropskih raziskovalcev je populacija Tainov drastično upadla zaradi španskih osvajalcev.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Po podatkih Frayja Bartoloméja de las Casasa (Tratado de las Indias) so španski osvajalci med letom 1492 in 1498 ubili približno 100.000 Tainov.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Ta prostor je bil zgrajen kot atrij samostana iz 17. stoletja, od katerega je preživela samo zgradba Templo de San Diego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Zdaj se uporablja kot osrednji trg, kjer je vedno živahno, tako podnevi kot ponoči.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Vrt obdaja več restavracij, v osrednjem paviljonu pa se popoldan in zvečer pogosto odvijajo brezplačni koncerti.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (ulica poljuba). Dva balkona, ki ju ločuje zgolj 69 centimetrov, sta domovanje stare legende o ljubezni.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Nekateri otroci vam bodo zgodbo povedali za le nekaj penijev.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Otok Bowen je priljubljena izletniška točka za enodnevne izlete ali krajša potovanja ob koncu tedna, saj nudi vožnje s kajaki, pohodniške izlete, trgovine, restavracije itd.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ta avtentična skupnost se nahaja v mestu Howe Sound v bližini Vancouvra, do katerega je mogoče priti z eno od rednih linij vodnih taksijev z izhodiščem na otoku Granville v mestnem središču Vancouvra.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Če uživate v aktivnostih na prostem, morate obvezno poskusiti treking po koridorju Od morja do neba.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 ure vožnje iz Vancouvra) je drag, vendar je dobro poznan zaradi zimskih olimpijskih iger 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Pozimi si lahko privoščite enega najlepših smučarskih doživetij v Severni Ameriki, poleti pa se lahko preizkusite v gorskem kolesarjenju.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Dovoljenja je treba rezervirati vnaprej. Če želite v Sireni ostati čez noč, morate imeti dovoljenje.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena je edina čuvajska postojanka, ki poleg kampiranja ponuja nastanitev s skupnimi sobami in toplimi obroki. La Leona, San Pedrillo in Los Patos ponujajo samo kampiranje brez možnosti prehrane.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Parkirna dovoljenja lahko pridobite neposredno v naravovarstveni nadzorni postaji v Puertu Jiménezu, vendar ne sprejemajo kreditnih kartic.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Služba upravljanja parka (MINAE) ne izdaja dovoljenj za prenočitev več kot mesec dni pred predvidenim prihodom.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ponuja storitev rezervacij za pristojbino v višini 30 ameriških dolarjev ali 10 ameriških dolarjev za dnevno prepustnico; podrobnosti so na voljo na njihovi strani Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cookovi otoki so otoška država v prosti zvezi z Novo Zelandijo, ki se nahajajo v Polineziji, na sredini Južnega Tihega oceana.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Gre za arhipelag s 15 otoki, razpršenimi po oceanu na površini 2,2 milijona km2.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ker so otoki v istem časovnem pasu kot Havaji, jih včasih imenujejo "Havaji tam spodaj".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Čeprav je manjši, nekatere starejše obiskovalce spominja na Havaje preden so ti postali država in so bili brez vseh velikih hotelov za turiste in drugih novogradenj.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cookovi otoki nimajo mest, ampak so sestavljeni iz 15 različnih otokov. Glavna otoka sta Rarotonga in Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Danes je v razvitih državah ponujanje razkošne nočitve z zajtrkom postalo prava umetnost.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: B&B-ji na najvišji ravni seveda tekmujejo predvsem v dveh glavnih stvareh: prenočevanju in zajtrkovanju.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Zato lahko v najboljših tovrstnih nastanitvah najdete najbolj prestižno posteljnino, morda celo kakšno ročno izdelano prešito odejo ali starinsko posteljo.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Za zajtrk lahko postrežejo sezonske dobrote iz te regije ali pa gostiteljevo specialiteto.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Nahajajo se lahko v zgodovinski, starejši zgradbi s starinskim pohištvom, urejenim zemljiščem in bazenom.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Preprostost tega, da sedeš v avto in se odpraviš na dolgo pot, ima svoj čar.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Za razliko od večjih vozil, verjetno že veste, kako voziti svoj avto, in poznate njegove omejitve.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Postavitev šotora na zasebnem zemljišču ali v kraju kakršnekoli velikosti lahko hitro pritegne neželeno pozornost.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Avtomobil je skratka odlično sredstvo za cestna potovanja, a je kot tak le redko primeren za "kampiranje".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kampiranje z avtomobilom je mogoče, če imate velik enoprostorec, terensko vozilo ali karavan s sedeži, ki jih je mogoče podreti.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: V nekaterih hotelih lahko najdemo zapuščino zlate dobe parnih lokomotiv in prekooceanskih ladij; izpred druge svetovne vojne, in sicer iz 19. in začetka 20. stoletja.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: To so bili hoteli, v katerih so bivali bogataši in slavni takratnega časa, in so pogosto nudili odlične restavracije ter nočno življenje.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Del njihovega karakterja so tudi staromodna notranja oprema, odsotnost najnovejših pripomočkov in nekakšna prefinjena postaranost.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Običajno so sicer v zasebni lasti, včasih pa pod streho sprejmejo tudi voditelje držav in druge dostojanstvenike, ki pridejo na obisk.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Popotniki s kupi denarja si lahko privoščijo let okrog sveta z vmesnimi postanki v katerem od teh hotelov.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Mreža izmenjave gostoljubja je organizacija, ki popotnike povezuje z lokalnimi prebivalci v mestih, ki jih nameravajo obiskati.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Za sprejem v mrežo je običajno potrebno zgolj izpolniti spletni obrazec, vendar pa nekatere mreže ponujajo ali zahtevajo dodatno potrditev.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Seznam razpoložljivih gostiteljev je nato na voljo v tiskani obliki in/ali na spletu, včasih z referencami in ocenami drugih popotnikov.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Kavčanje je nastalo januarja 2004, potem ko je računalniški programer Casey Fenton našel poceni let na Islandijo, vendar ni imel kje bivati.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Študentom tamkajšnje univerze je poslal e-poštno sporočilo in prejel neverjetno veliko ponudb za brezplačno nastanitev.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hostli so primarno namenjeni mladim – tipičen gost je star od 20 do 29 let – pogosto pa se v njih znajdejo tudi starejši.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Družine z otroki so redek prizor, nekateri hostli pa jim vendarle omogočajo bivanje v zasebnih sobah.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Zimske olimpijske igre 2022 bo gostil Peking na Kitajskem, ki bo tako postal prvo mesto, ki bo gostilo tako poletno kot zimsko olimpijado.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: V Pekingu bo potekala otvoritvena in zaključna slovesnost, kot tudi dvoranski nastopi na ledu.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Druge smučarske prireditve se bodo odvijale na smučišču Taizicheng v Zhangjiakou, približno 220 km (140 milj) od Pekinga.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Večina templjev ima letni festival v obdobju od konca novembra do sredine maja, ki se razlikuje glede na letni koledar posameznega templja.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Večina tempeljskih festivalov se praznuje kot del obletnice templja, rojstnega dneva božanstva, ki tam biva, ali katerega koli drugega večjega dogodka, ki je povezan s templjem.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Tempeljski festivali v Kerali so zelo zanimivi za ogled, vključno z običajno povorko okrašenih slonov, tempeljskim orkestrom in drugimi slovesnostmi.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Svetovni sejem (splošno znan tudi kot svetovna razstava ali preprosto razstava) je velik mednarodni festival umetnosti in znanosti.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Sodelujoče države v narodnih paviljonih predstavljajo umetniške in izobraževalne razstave, s katerimi izpostavljajo svetovne problematike ali kulturo in zgodovino svoje države.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Mednarodne vrtnarske razstave so specializirani dogodki s cvetličnimi razstavami, botaničnimi vrtovi in drugimi dejavnostmi, povezanimi z rastlinami.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Čeprav se teoretično lahko odvijajo vsako leto (dokler so v različnih državah), se praktično to ne zgodi.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Prireditve običajno trajajo od tri do šest mesecev in se odvijajo na mestih, velikih najmanj 50 hektarjev.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Skozi leta se je uporabljalo veliko različnih formatov filma. Standardni 35-milimetrski film (negativ 36 x 24 mm) je najbolj pogost.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Običajno ga lahko takoj zamenjate, ko ga zmanjka, zagotavlja pa približno enako ločljivost kot sodobne naprave DSLR.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Nekateri fotoaparati srednjega formata uporabljajo format 6 krat 6, natančneje negativ 56 krat 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: To zagotavlja skoraj štirikrat boljšo ločljivost od 35-mm negativa (3136 mm2 proti 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Prostoživeče živali so za fotografa eden od najzahtevnejših motivov, ki zahteva kombinacijo sreče, potrpežljivosti, izkušenj in dobre opreme.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografiranje prostoživečih živali pogosto jemljemo kot nekaj samoumevnega, vendar na splošno za fotografiranje drži, da je slika vredna več kot tisoč besed.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Za fotografiranje prostoživečih živali je običajno potreben dolg teleobjektiv, jate ptic ali majhna bitja in podobno pa terjajo uporabo drugih objektivov.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Veliko eksotičnih živali je težko najti, parki pa imajo včasih pravila o fotografiranju za komercialno uporabo.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Divje živali so lahko plahe ali pa napadalne. Okolje je lahko hladno, vroče ali kako drugače neprijazno.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Na svetu je več kot 5000 različnih jezikov, od katerih ima več kot dvajset vsaj 50 milijonov govorcev.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Običajno je zapisane besede tudi lažje razumeti kot izgovorjene besede. To še posebej drži za naslove, ki jih je velikokrat težko izgovoriti na razumljiv način.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Veliko celotnih narodov popolnoma tekoče govori angleško, pri še več narodih pa lahko pričakujete omejeno znanje jezika – še posebej pri mlajših osebah.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Predstavljajte si, da za mizo pri večerji v restavraciji v Torontu sedijo, recimo nekdo iz Manchestra, Bostona, Jamajke in Sydneyja.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Pripovedujejo si zgodbe iz svojih domačih mest, pri čemer uporabljajo značilen naglas in domače narečje.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kupovanje hrane v supermarketih je ponavadi najcenejši način, kako se nahraniti. Če kuhanje ni mogoče, pa so možnosti omejene na že pripravljeno hrano.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Supermarketi ponujajo vse bolj raznoliko izbiro že pripravljene hrane. V nekaterih lahko najdete celo mikrovalovno pečico ali druge načine za gretje hrane.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: V nekaterih državah ali vrstah trgovin je vsaj ena restavracija v samem objektu, kjer vlada sproščeno vzdušje in imajo dostopne cene.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Naredite kopije police in kontaktnih podatkov vaše zavarovalnice ter jih nosite s seboj.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Vsebovati morajo zavarovančev e-poštni naslov in mednarodno telefonsko številko za vsakršno svetovanje/odobritev in vlaganje zahtevkov.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Še eno kopijo shranite med prtljago in na spletu (pošljite si e-poštno sporočilo s prilogo ali jo shranite v "oblak").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Če imate s seboj prenosni računalnik ali tablico, kopijo shranite v spomin ali na disk (dostopen brez interneta).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Kopije police/kontaktov dajte tudi svoji sopotnikom in sorodnikom oziroma prijateljem doma, ki so vam pripravljeni pomagati.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Losi (znani tudi kot kanadski jeleni) po naravi niso agresivni, ampak se bodo branili, če zaznajo nevarnost.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Če ljudje losa ne dojemajo kot potencialno nevarnega, se mu lahko preveč približajo in se tako izpostavijo nevarnosti.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Alkoholne pijače pijte zmerno. Alkohol na vsakogar vpliva drugače in pomembno je, da veste, kje so vaše meje.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Morebitni dolgoročni stranski učinki prekomernega pitja lahko vključujejo poškodbe jeter in celo slepoto in smrt. Mogoča nevarnost je še toliko večja, ko gre za uživanje nezakonito pridelanega alkohola.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Nezakonite žgane pijače lahko vsebujejo nevarne nečistoče, vključno z metanolom, ki lahko že v majhnih količinah povzroči slepoto ali smrt.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Očala so lahko v drugi državi cenejša, še posebej v državah z nizkimi dohodki, kjer so stroški dela nižji.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Razmislite o možnosti, da očesni pregled opravite doma, še posebej če ga pokriva zavarovanje, recept pa lahko vzamete s seboj ter ga koristite drugje.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Prestižne znamke okvirjev, ki so na voljo na takšnih območjih, so lahko dvojno problematične; nekateri okvirji so lahko ponaredki, tisti pristni uvoženi pa so lahko dražji kot doma.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kava je ena izmed izdelkov, s katerim se po svetu največ trguje, v domačem kraju pa boste verjetno našli veliko njenih vrst.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Vseeno pa na svetu obstajajo številni posebni načini pitja kave, ki jih je vredno doživeti na lastni koži.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Bistvo soteskanja (ali kanjoninga) je doseči dno soteske, ki je lahko suha ali polna vode.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Soteskanje združuje elemente plavanja, plezanja in skakanja – vendar za začetek zahteva relativno malo urjenja ali dobre telesne pripravljenosti (v primerjavi z npr. skalnim plezanjem, potapljanjem z jeklenko ali alpskim smučanjem).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Pohodništvo je aktivnost na prostem, ki zajema hojo v naravnem okolju, pogosto po pešpoteh.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Dnevno pohodništvo vključuje razdalje od manj kot miljo do daljših razdalj, ki jih je mogoče prehoditi v enem dnevu.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Celodnevni pohod po lahki pohodniški poti zahteva le malo priprav in udeležijo se ga lahko vse osebe z zmerno kondicijo.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Družine z majhnimi otroki se bodo morale verjetno bolje pripraviti, a preživljanje dneva na prostem je prav tako lahko izvedljivo tudi z dojenčki in predšolskimi otroki.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: V mednarodnem prostoru obstaja skoraj 200 organizacij za tekaške oglede, ki večinoma delujejo samostojno.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Go Running Tours, ki je naslednik Global Running Tours, povezuje na desetine ponudnikov ogledovanja znamenitosti med tekom na štirih celinah.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Po vzoru barcelonskega Running Tours Barcelona in kopenhagenskega Running Copenhagen so mu hitro sledili Running Tours Prague s sedežem v Pragi in ostali.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Preden in ko kam odpotujete, morate upoštevati veliko stvari.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ko potujete, ne pričakujte, da bodo stvari kot "doma". Obnašanje, zakoni, hrana, promet, nastanitev, standardi, jezik in tako dalje bodo do neke mere drugačni kot tam, kjer živite.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: To si vedno zapomnite, da ne boste razočarani ali zgroženi nad lokalnim načinom vedenja.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Potovalne agencije obstajajo od 19. stoletja. Potovalni agent je po navadi dobra izbira za potovanje, ki presega prejšnje popotnikove izkušnje iz narave, kulture, jezika ali držav z nizkim prihodkom.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Čeprav je večina agencij pripravljena opraviti najobičajnejše rezervacije, se veliko agentov specializira za določene vrste potovanj, finančnih obsegov ali destinacij.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Včasih se je bolje obrniti na agenta, ki pogosto nudi izlete podobne vašemu.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Na spletnem mestu ali v izložbi preverite, katera potovanja, ki jih ponuja agencija, so znižana.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Če si svet želite ogledati poceni, bodisi zaradi nuje, življenjskega sloga ali izziva, je za to na voljo nekaj načinov.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: V bistvu obstajata dve kategoriji: lahko delate, medtem ko potujete, ali pa poskusite omejiti svoje izdatke. Ta članek se osredotoča na drugo.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Če ste se pripravljeni odreči udobju, času in predvidljivosti, da bi oklestili stroške skoraj na ničlo, glejte razdelek nizkoproračunsko potovanje.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Ta priporočila izključujejo krajo popotnikov, motenje posesti, kupovanje in prodajanje na črnem trgu, prosjačenje ali druge načine izkoriščanja drugih za lastno korist.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Kontrolna točka za priseljevanje je ponavadi prva postaja pri izkrcanju iz letala, ladje ali drugega vozila.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Na nekaterih čezmejnih vlakih preglede izvajajo med samo vožnjo, zato morate imeti s sabo veljavno osebno izkaznico, ko se vkrcate na tak vlak.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Na nočnih vlakih lahko sprevodnik pobere potne liste, da nič ne zmoti vašega spanja.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Registracija je dodatna zahteva v postopku pridobitve vizuma. V nekaterih državah morate pri lokalnih oblasteh registrirati svojo prisotnost in naslov bivanja.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: V ta namen boste morda morali izpolniti obrazec na lokalni policijski postaji ali obiskati urad za priseljence.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: V veliko državah s tovrstnim zakonom bodo za registracijo poskrbeli v lokalnih hotelih (ne pozabite jih prositi).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: V vseh ostalih primerih se morajo registrirati samo tisti, ki bivajo zunaj turističnih nastanitev. Vendar pa je zaradi tega zakon toliko bolj nejasen, zato se pozanimajte vnaprej.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arhitektura se ukvarja z načrtovanjem in gradnjo stavb. Arhitektura kraja je pogosto že sama po sebi turistična zanimivost.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Veliko zgradb je zelo lepih na pogled in razgled z visoke zgradbe ali dobro nameščenega okna je lahko prav čudovit.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arhitektura se v veliki meri prekriva z drugimi področji, na primer urbanizmom, gradbeništvom, umetnostno zgodovino, notranjim oblikovanjem in krajinsko arhitekturo.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Ker so nekateri pueblosi tako odročni, omembe vrednega nočnega življenja ne boste našli drugje kot v Albuquerqueju ali Santa Feju.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Skoraj vse zgoraj naštete igralnice pa strežejo pijačo in kar nekaj jih gosti znane obraze iz sveta zabave (predvsem velike igralnice v neposredni bližini Albuquerqueja in Santa Feja).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Bodite previdni: tukajšnji malomeščanski bari niso vedno najboljši kraj za zbiranje in druženje prišlekov iz tujine.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Natančne zahteve preverite pri instituciji in tudi pri uradu za priseljevanje države, v kateri želite študirati.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Če niste diplomat, delo na drugi strani oceana običajno pomeni, da boste morali vložiti davek od dohodka v državi, v kateri ste.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Dohodnina je v različnih državah različno strukturirana, davčne stopnje in razredi pa se od ene države do druge močno razlikujejo.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: V nekaterih zveznih državah, kot so Združene države Amerike in Kanada, se dohodnina odmerja na državni in lokalni ravni, zato se lahko stopnje in razredi razlikujejo glede na regijo.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Čeprav je pregled na meji ob vrnitvi v domovino ponavadi zgolj formalnost ali pa ga ni, je pregled na carini lahko zoprn.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Preverite, kaj lahko vnesete in česar ne, ter prijavite vse, kar presega pravne omejitve.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: V poslu pisanja potopisov boste najlažje začeli tako, da svoje veščine izpilite na spletnem mestu uveljavljenega popotniškega spletnega dnevnika.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Potem ko se privadite oblikovanja in urejanja na spletu, boste kasneje morda lahko ustvarili svoje spletno mesto.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Prostovoljno delo med potovanjem je odličen način, kako prispevati k spremembam, ampak ni vse v razdajanju sebe.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Življenje in prostovoljstvo v tuji državi je odličen način za spoznavanje različnih kultur, novih ljudi in sebe, za pridobivanje širše perspektive ter celo pridobivanje novih veščin.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: To je tudi dober način za prihranek denarja in podaljšanje bivanja, saj veliko prostovoljnih del krije posteljo in hrano, nekatera pa celo nudijo skromno plačo.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikingi so uporabljali ruske vodne poti, da so prišli do Črnega in Kaspijskega morja. Del teh poti je še vedno uporaben. Preverite, ali potrebujete posebno dovoljenje, ki ga je morda težko dobiti.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Belomorsko-Baltski prekop povezuje Arktični ocean z Baltskim morjem prek Oneškega jezera, Ladoškega jezera in Sankt Peterburga, večinoma po rekah in jezerih.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Oneško jezero je povezano tudi z Volgo, zato je v Rusijo še vedno mogoče priti prek Kaspijskega jezera.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Ko boste prispeli do pristanišč, vam bo že marsikaj precej jasno. Spoznali boste ostale druge popotnike na čolnih, ki vam bodo predali svoje informacije.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: V bistvu boste lepili obvestila, da nudite pomoč, hodili po pristanišču, se pogovarjali z ljudmi med čiščenjem njihovih jaht, poskušali vzpostaviti stik z mornarji v baru itd.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Poskusite govoriti s kar največ ljudmi. Čez nekaj časa vas bodo vsi poznali in vam bodo namignili, ali na kateri ladji iščejo nekoga.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Letalsko družbo za redne potnike, ki je v zvezi letalskih prevoznikov, morate izbrati previdno.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Čeprav morda mislite, da se je smiselno pridružiti letalski družbi, s katero letite največ, se morate zavedati, da se ponujene prednosti pogosto razlikujejo, s točkami za redne potnike pa bodo morda bolj radodarni pri drugi letalski družbi znotraj iste zveze.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Letalske družbe, kot so Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways in Turkish Airlines, so močno razširile svoje storitve po Afriki ter ponujajo povezave s številnimi glavnimi afriškimi mesti po bolj konkurenčnih cenah kot druge evropske letalske družbe.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Družba Turkish Airlines od leta 2014 leti v 39 destinacij v 30 afriških državah.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Če vam ostane nekaj časa za potovanje, preverite, koliko znaša skupna cena prevoza v Afriko v primerjavi s ceno prevoza okoli sveta.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ne pozabite všteti dodatnih stroškov naknadnih vizumov, odhodnih taks, kopenskega prevoza itd, za vse kraje izven Afrike.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Če želite leteti okoli sveta le po južni polobli, je izbira letov in destinacij omejena zaradi pomanjkanja čezoceanskih poti.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Vseh treh prekooceanskih linij na južni polobli ne pokriva nobena zveza letalskih prevoznikov (SkyTeam pa ne pokriva nobene od linij).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Star Alliance pokriva vse razen vzhodnega Južnega Tihega oceana od Santiaga de Chile do Tahitija, kjer leti LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Poleg tega leta obstajajo še druge možnosti, če se želite izogniti Južnemu Pacifiku in zahodni obali Južne Amerike (glejte spodaj).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Leta 1994 se je etnično armenska regija Gorski Karabah v Azerbajdžanu vojskovala z Azeri.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: S podporo Armenije je bila ustanovljena nova republika. Vendar je uradno ne priznava nobena uradna država – niti Armenija.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Diplomatski spori o regiji še naprej kvarijo odnose med Armenijo in Azerbajdžanom.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Okrožje Canal (nizozemsko: Grachtengordel) je slavno okrožje iz 17. stoletja, ki obkroža Binnenstad ali notranje mesto Amsterdama.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Celotno okrožje je zaščiteno kot Unescovo območje svetovne dediščine zaradi svoje edinstvene kulturne in zgodovinske vrednosti, zemljišča na tem območju pa dosegajo najvišje cene v celi državi.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, kar pomeni pet zemlja, obsegajo pet majhnih obalnih vasi Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza in Monterosso, ki se nahajajo v italijanski pokrajini Liguriji.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Uvrščene so na Unescov seznam svetovne dediščine.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ljudje so skozi stoletja na razgibanem, strmem površju vse do pečin, ki se dvigujejo nad morjem, skrbno gradili terase.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Še očarljivejši je zaradi odsotnosti vidnega podjetniškega razvoja. Vasi povezujejo poti, vlaki in čolni, z avtomobili pa od zunaj ni mogoče priti do njih.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Različici francoščine, ki ju uporabljajo v Belgiji in Švici, se rahlo razlikujeta od francoščine, ki jo govorijo v Franciji, a sta ji dovolj podobni, da se njihovi govorci medsebojno razumejo.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Posebno sistem številčenja v francosko govoreči Belgiji in Švici ima nekaj posebnosti, po katerih se razlikuje od francoščine, ki jo govorijo v Franciji, različna pa je tudi izgovorjava nekaterih besed.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Vendar pa so se vsi francosko govoreči Belgijci in Švicarji v šoli verjetno učili standardne francoščine, zato bi vas morali razumeti, tudi če uporabljate standardni francoski sistem številčenja.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: V številnih krajih po svetu mahanje velja za prijazno gesto, ki pomeni "zdravo".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: V Maleziji, vsaj med Malezijci na podeželju, pa podobno kot gesta premikanja kazalca proti telesu v določenih Zahodnih državah pomeni "pridi sem", in bi se moralo uporabljati le za to.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Podobno lahko britanski popotnik v Španiji mahanje v slovo z dlanjo obrnjeno proti tistemu, ki maha (namesto proti osebi, ki ji maha), zmotno razume kot kretnjo, ki ga kliče nazaj.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Pomožni jeziki so umetni ali sestavljeni jeziki, ustvarjeni za lažjo sporazumevanje med ljudmi, ki bi jim sicer sporazumevanje povzročalo težave.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Razlikujejo se od jezikov lingua franca, naravnih ali organskih jezikov, ki iz nekega razloga postanejo glavno sredstvo komunikacije med govorci drugih jezikov.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Zaradi vročine lahko popotniki dobijo privide, ki dajejo vtis vode (ali drugih stvari).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Ti prividi so lahko nevarni, če jih popotnik poskuša doseči, saj s tem izgublja dragoceno energijo in preostalo vodo.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Še tako vroča puščava se lahko ponoči izjemno ohladi. Brez toplih oblačil obstaja resna nevarnost za podhladitev.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Poleti morate še posebno paziti na komarje, če se boste odločili za sprehod skozi deževni gozd.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Tudi če se skozi subtropski deževni gozd peljete, je nekaj sekund, ko so vrata odprta medtem, ko vstopate v vozilo, dovolj, da komarji vstopijo z vami.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: S ptičjo gripo, ki se uradno imenuje aviarna influenca, se lahko okužijo tako ptiči kot sesalci.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Pri ljudeh so do sedaj zabeležili manj kot tisoč primerov, a se je nekaj teh končalo s smrtjo.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Večina je zadevala ljudi, ki delajo s perutnino, vendar so določenemu tveganju izpostavljeni tudi opazovalci ptic.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Za Norveško so značilni strmi fjordi in doline, ki se kot bi odrezal umaknejo visoki, pretežno ravni planoti.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Te planote se pogosto imenujejo "vidde", kar pomeni širok, odprt prostor brez dreves, brezmejno prostranstvo.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: V Rogalandu in Agderju so običajno poimenovane "hei", kar pomeni golo barje, večinoma pokrito z vreso.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Ledeniki niso stabilni, ampak tečejo iz gore. Pri tem nastajajo razpoke, prelomi, ki jih lahko zastirajo snežni mostovi.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Zidovi in strehe ledenih votlin se lahko vdrejo in zaprejo razpoke.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Na robu ledenikov se lahko odlomijo ogromni kosi, ki padejo in se morda tudi odbijejo ali zakotalijo daleč od roba.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Vrhunec turistične sezone gorskih postaj je običajno v času indijskega poletja.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Pozimi so drugače lepe in očarljive in veliko hribovskih letovišč dobro zasneži in tako ponujajo aktivnosti, kot so smučanje in deskanje.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Prevoznine v primeru smrti v družini, ki nekoliko znižajo strošek poti na pogreb tik pred zdajci, ponuja le še nekaj letalskih družb.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: To med drugimi ponujajo tudi letalske družbe Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa za lete, ki odhajajo iz Združenih držav ali Kanade, in WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: V vsakem primeru morate za rezervacijo neposredno poklicati letalsko družbo.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
